# Microsoft FY2024 Gross Margin

**Source data:** Revenue of $245,122 million and cost of revenue of $74,114 million for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024 [DOC: msft_10k_fy2024.txt — "Fiscal year ended June 30, 2024: Revenue $245,122; Cost of revenue $74,114"], from Microsoft Corporation's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2024 (accession 0000950170-24-087843) [DOC: msft_10k_fy2024.txt].

**Calculation:**
- Gross margin (dollars) = $245,122M − $74,114M = **$171,008 million**
- Gross margin (percent) = $171,008M ÷ $245,122M = **69.8%**

**Prior-year comparison** (FY2023: revenue $211,915M, cost of revenue $65,863M) [DOC: msft_10k_fy2024.txt]:
- FY2023 gross margin = $146,052M, or 68.9% of revenue
- Year-over-year: gross margin dollars up $24,956M (+17.1%); gross margin rate up ~0.8 percentage points

**Comparability note:** Both periods are Microsoft's own fiscal years ending June 30 and are presented on the same basis within the same filing, so they are directly comparable. Note that Microsoft's reported FY2023 segment/revenue-line presentation was recast in FY2024 for its reorganized reporting structure, but the consolidated revenue and cost-of-revenue totals used here are unaffected. This figure is the consolidated company-wide margin; it is not a hardware-only or segment-level margin.

ANSWER: $171,008 million gross margin, or approximately 69.8% of revenue (revenue $245,122M less cost of revenue $74,114M) for FY2024
